CHRONOLOGICAL-V2.model: FAPT-Guard ensemble 0.5 Markov + 0.25 RF + 0.25 Gradient Boosting
CHRONOLOGICAL-V2.features: future_prediction_v2: suffixes 1/2/3, counts/transitions, elapsed/last interval, source/action counts, recent3/repeats/last tactics; no identity or absolute dates
CHRONOLOGICAL-V2.preprocessing: Timestamp sorting, strict prefix whitelist and label availability; midpoint per scenario; exact path/identity rejection
CHRONOLOGICAL-V2.calibration: Temperature on 50 calibration sequences, selected T=1
CHRONOLOGICAL-V2.test_usage: 150 chronologically latest sequences; previously evaluated under v1 then expanded model search; all baseline rows identical
CHRONOLOGICAL-V2.test_influenced_tuning: Code selects on validation only. Prior test exposure means adaptive human influence cannot be excluded; exploratory, not confirmatory. Historical random experiment used some of these groups for training.

V2-RANDOM-TRANSITION.features: Existing sequence_features whitelist; selected model uses only last 3/2/1 mapped techniques, then global training prior. Unsmoothed raw counts; calibration floor applied separately.
V2-RANDOM-TRANSITION.preprocessing: Source labels normalized via pinned ATT&CK; original shuffled whole-scenario split; all adjacent training prefixes, random stored cutoff for held-out groups
V2-RANDOM-TRANSITION.calibration: 75 probability-calibration rows; temperature 4.0, log probability floor 1e-6
V2-RANDOM-TRANSITION.conformal: 75 separate rows; LAC score 1-p(true), q=0.9885469306569868, target90%; test coverage89.3333%, average set11.4067
V2-RANDOM-TRANSITION.test_usage: 150 random-group test samples; calendar periods overlap partitions. Interactive demonstrations subsequently expose test labels.
V2-RANDOM-TRANSITION.test_influenced_tuning: Training code fixes transition model and fits temperature on calibration only. No evidence of test-based parameter optimization; prior development history cannot be reconstructed solely from artifacts. Random group split is not chronological.

INC-00001-DEMO.split: No benchmark partition; same model/provenance as V2-RANDOM-TRANSITION
INC-00001-DEMO.preprocessing: Incident evidence prefix and candidate mapping; not independent target labels
INC-00001-DEMO.conformal: Same historical population calibration; no empirical incident coverage
INC-00001-DEMO.test_usage: Never count INC-00001 as test sample; PENDING_GROUND_TRUTH
INC-00001-DEMO.test_influenced_tuning: No fit or tuning performed by incident inference

raw_support.formula: Model output probability = target count / total matching training samples

features.available_features: Last 1/2/3 mapped techniques, technique and transition counts, event/mapped counts, elapsed time, last interval, source counts
features.excluded: Targets, future events, incident/scenario/template IDs, sample IDs and split

V1-TEMPLATE.preprocessing: Pinned STIX replacement normalization; preserve original CSV; supplied template split
V1-TEMPLATE.conformal: NOT MEASURED; insufficient independent sequence groups
V1-TEMPLATE.test_usage: 360 adjacent prefixes from 60 test scenarios; repeated templates/full paths limit independence
V1-TEMPLATE.test_influenced_tuning: Highest validation macro-F1; ties favor transition frequency. Test never used for fitting or selection.
